Monitoring: Look for annual, erect, broad green- leaved parasitic weed (30-100cm high).
Striga hermontica has large pink flowers, while
Striga asiatica has small purple flowers
Look for yellowish blotches in crop foliage about 1 cm long by 0.5 cm wide or stunted crop growth, even if the weed has not emerged.
Uprooting may confirm the presence of young parasite seedlings on the roots
Regulary (every two weeks) check for flowering and seed development to prevent seed set, spread and build up of seed bank in the field
